body.name: Observable subresultant chart
body.construction: Write \(P_3(z)=p_3z^3+p_2z^2+p_1z+p_0\) and \(Q_3(z)=q_3z^3+q_2z^2+q_1z+q_0\). Form the first Sylvester subresultant \(\operatorname{Sres}_1(P_3,Q_3)(z)=s_1z+s_0\) using the explicit coefficient polynomials declared in the symbol table, and set \(D=v\chi p_3q_3s_1\).
